content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks online

Sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a foundational approach for digital creators who are excluded from traditional payment platforms. With only 46 out of 195 countries supported by Stripe, millions find themselves unable to accept payments for their digital products. This creates a significant barrier to entry in the global marketplace. By adopting an infrastructure that prioritizes ownership and control, creators can bypass these restrictions altogether, ensuring they can sell their ebooks and other digital goods without fear of account suspension or payment delays.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this infrastructure is a combination of free and paid tools that work harmoniously to create a seamless online store. Using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting allows creators to establish a reliable website without incurring costs. Backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which provides flexibility and scalability. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which facilitates automatic on-chain crypto payments with a minimal fee. Together, these components form a robust framework that empowers creators to manage their sales independently.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable. Whether you are in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or Pakistan, you can leverage these tools to create a fully operational online store. By using this architecture, you gain complete control over your sales, data, and customer interactions. It eliminates dependency on third-party platforms that can impose arbitrary restrictions, ensuring you can maintain your revenue stream and serve your audience effectively.
Own your data and sales without relying on third-party platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack comprises several essential components that collectively facilitate online sales. Hosting via GitHub or Cloudflare offers a cost-effective solution for your website. Payment processing through NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Additionally, using Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage ensures that you have complete ownership of your data. Each element is designed to integrate seamlessly, providing a cohesive platform for sales and customer management.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with building your online store, first, select your preferred hosting option, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing and configure your order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, load your products and enable file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers an end-to-end tested deployment with full support.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
No subscriptions or hidden fees—just pure ownership.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose between GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your store. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Add your digital products and configure file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for an end-to-end solution.
